effect.name: CRT
effect.description: A whole tube in one pass: barrel curvature, scanlines, a shadow mask and a vignette, with the area outside the glass blacked out. Everything can be dialled to zero, so you can keep just the parts you want.
effect.author: CyberMushroom

parameter.name: Bezel Colour
parameter.description: What shows outside the curved glass.

parameter.name: Curvature
parameter.description: How much the picture bows outward. 0 is a flat panel.

parameter.name: Line Spacing
parameter.description: Texels from one scanline to the next.

parameter.name: Shadow Mask
parameter.description: Strength of the RGB stripe mask. Only visible if the image is drawn at 3 or more screen pixels per texel.

parameter.name: Brightness
parameter.description: Lifts the picture back up - scanlines and mask both cost light.
